name: Wonderful Love
source:
One day, the protagonist girl came to have an ability by chance, understanding what dogs says.
The mysterious girl who understand dog's language have sex with her beloved dog John, gets humiliated by a neighborhood savage dog, and eaten by her male friend...... In this game she will experience full of ups and downs.
In park, house, hill, shrine, sidewalk ... she is getting fucked in many kinds of places.

translation:
某天，女主角意外获得了理解狗语的能力。
这名能听懂狗语的神秘少女，将与心爱的狗约翰发生性关系，遭到邻居家凶狠恶犬的凌辱，甚至被男性朋友“吃掉”……她将在本作中经历一段跌宕起伏的生活。
公园、家中、山丘、神社、人行道……她会在各种场所与人或狗发生性关系。
